item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Look Ahead to Next Round of Talks
item.description: Iran’s foreign minister said that new negotiations with the United States would start immediately after their preliminary deal is signed on Friday. President Trump said he hoped the conflict would soon be in the “rearview mirror.”

item.title: Live Updates: Ukraine and Middle East Are Focus as Group of 7 Leaders Meet
item.description: After the U.S. reached a preliminary deal with Iran, the mood seemed lighter than had been expected. President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine was hoping to shift leaders’ attention to the war with Russia.

item.title: Iran Will Enter Nuclear Talks Feeling Emboldened
item.description: Despite military setbacks during the war, Tehran is presenting a narrative of victory before negotiations with Washington.

item.title: Ukraine Targets Moscow Oil Facility With Drones as G7 Leaders Meet
item.description: A day earlier, Russia bombarded Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities with missiles and drones, killing at least 11 people and damaging a holy cathedral.
